title: Lab LCP 48.9s on mobile
summary: The page's main content takes 48.9 seconds to appear on a mid-range phone, causing most visitors to bounce before they can convert.
problem: The page's main content takes 48.9 seconds to appear on a mid-range phone, causing most visitors to bounce before they can convert.
evidence: Lighthouse (mobile emulation, single synthetic run via DataForSEO): Largest Contentful Paint 48.9 s against a ‘good’ threshold of 2500ms. Lab data, not real-user field data — confirms the defect class, not the field percentile.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

title: Competing CTAs split funnel
summary: Multiple competing CTAs on the homepage create ambiguity about the primary conversion path, diluting user focus.
problem: Multiple competing CTAs on the homepage create ambiguity about the primary conversion path, diluting user focus.
recommended_change: h1: Reliable Internet That Works Anywhere in the U.S.; cta: CHECK COVERAGE; notes: Consolidate to a single primary CTA (CHECK COVERAGE) and demote secondary CTAs to text links or secondary button style.
evidence: 7 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS”, “SEE MY OPTIONS”, “GET STARTED”, “START CHAT”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift
